articles.summary: Howdy all, We’ve rolled out WP Workbench 2.1.2 plugin for all Virtualmin Pro users. Changes since 2.1.1: Add automatic WP-CLI installation when refreshing instances if missing Fix JSON parsing when WP-CLI emits PHP warnings to stdout Fix backup form submission to work when opened through a remote link Changes since 2.1.0: Fix the icons used in the system information on the dashboard
